Build a workflow

Connect steps into a repeatable process and inspect the result of each run.

Plan a small first flow

Start with a text input, a model step, and an output. For example, turn a paragraph into a short summary. Add tools and knowledge retrieval after this simple flow works.

Build and test

  1. Create a Workflow application and open its workflow editor.
  2. Define the input on the start node and add an LLM node. Select the model on that node.
  3. Write the model instructions and insert the input using the editor’s variable selector.
  4. Connect the steps to an end node and map the model result to the output.
  5. Save the workflow and address any validation errors. Run it with a short sample and inspect the output and any failed steps.

Extend carefully

Add a knowledge-retrieval node when the model needs source documents. Add tools only when the process needs an external action. Check tool permissions and inputs before a test that changes external data.

If publication is blocked

Resolve graph validation errors and missing model configuration. A Workflow uses models on its LLM nodes; it does not require the same application-level model setting as a basic chatbot.
